bai: Bai 02 nhap lieu va lam quen thanh phan Excel

cau_hoi.A: Save cap nhat trang thai gan nhat; Save As tao file moi
cau_hoi.B: Save va Save As giong het nhau
cau_hoi.cau: Save va Save As giong va khac nhau the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giong khi dat ten lan dau; khac khi da co ten: Save cap nhat, Save As tao file moi.

cau_hoi.A: Khong doi duoc
cau_hoi.B: Doi duoc bang cach vao Control Panel > Region > Format chon English (US) hoac Vietnamese
cau_hoi.cau: Co doi duoc mac dinh nhap ngay truoc hay thang truoc khong?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Doi trong Region: US la thang truoc, Vietnam la ngay truoc.

cau_hoi.A: Chon Vietnamese thi nhap ngay/thang/nam
cau_hoi.cau: Neu chon Format la English (US) thi nhap ngay thang the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: US thi thang truoc ngay sau; Vietnam thi ngay truoc.

cau_hoi.A: Nam ben trai la Text, nam sat ben phai la so/ngay thang that
cau_hoi.cau: Cach nhan biet o nhap dung ngay thang/so hay dang Text?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Text can trai, so/ngay thang can phai.

cau_hoi.A: Insert > Picture > chon anh thoi khoa bieu de nhin mau
cau_hoi.cau: De co mau nhap lieu, video chen gi vao sheet?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Insert > Picture de chen anh mau thoi khoa bieu.

cau_hoi.A: Go Thu 2 roi keo fill handle (dau cong nho goc duoi phai) sang den Thu 6
cau_hoi.cau: Cach dien nhanh Thu 2 den Thu 6?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Go Thu 2 roi keo fill handle; Excel tu dien.

cau_hoi.A: Keo bien cot hoac double-click giua 2 tieu de cot
cau_hoi.cau: Khi noi dung Tiet 1 (7:30-8:15) bi che thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Keo rong hoac double-click AutoFit.

cau_hoi.A: Double-click vao o de sua, vi du sua Tiet 2, Tiet 3...
cau_hoi.cau: Cach sua noi dung trong o nhanh?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Double-click de sua truc tiep.

cau_hoi.A: Gop bang cach xoa
cau_hoi.D: Boi den B3:B6 > Home > Merge & Center de gop thanh SANG
cau_hoi.cau: Cach gop o B3:B6 thanh chu SANG?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Boi den roi Merge & Center.

cau_hoi.A: Chuot phai > Format Cells > Border > chon gach cheo > OK
cau_hoi.cau: Cach tao gach cheo trong o B2?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Format Cells > Border > gach cheo.

cau_hoi.A: Giu Alt + Enter de xuong dong, dung Space de can chu
cau_hoi.cau: Cach viet 2 dong Thoi gian / Buoi trong 1 o?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Alt+Enter xuong dong trong o.

cau_hoi.A: Boi den vung tieu de > Home > mau nen vang, mau chu do, chu dam B
cau_hoi.cau: Cach to mau nen va chu cho tieu de?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dung Fill Color va Font Color.

cau_hoi.A: Nhap mon hoc dang Toan: Co A - Dia ly...
cau_hoi.D: Nhap tu do khong can mau
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du nhap mon hoc Thu 2 trong video?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhap theo mau trong anh thoi khoa bieu.

cau_hoi.A: Chuot phai vao anh > Cut de xoa anh mau
cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi nhap xong thi xu ly anh mau the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chuot phai > Cut de xoa anh.

cau_hoi.A: Formula Bar hien noi dung that: Text thi hien text, cong thuc thi hien cong thuc
cau_hoi.D: Formula Bar khong co tac dung
cau_hoi.cau: Thanh Formula Bar co tac dung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hien noi dung that cua o, dac biet la cong thuc.

cau_hoi.A: Name Box hien dia chi o hoac vung; co the dat ten vung
cau_hoi.cau: O Name Box ben trai Formula Bar co tac dung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hien dia chi o, co the dat ten vung.

cau_hoi.A: File: New, Open, Info, Save, Save As, Print, Export, Close, Options
cau_hoi.cau: The File chua nhung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: New, Open, Info, Save, Save As, Print, Export, Close, Options.

cau_hoi.A: New > Blank workbook hoac chon Template lich, bang bieu co san
cau_hoi.cau: Trong File > New co gi dac biet?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Co Blank workbook va nhieu Template san.

cau_hoi.A: Home, Insert, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View
cau_hoi.cau: Cac the (Tab) Ribbon chinh la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Home, Insert, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View.

cau_hoi.A: Moi the chua cac nhom lenh, moi nhom chua cac chuc nang cu the
cau_hoi.cau: Cau truc cua moi the Ribbon?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: The > nhom lenh > chuc nang cu the.

cau_hoi.A: B dam, I nghieng, U gach chan; nhan lai de bo
cau_hoi.cau: Cac nut B, I, U trong nhom Font la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bold, Italic, Underline.

cau_hoi.A: Chon font chu phu thuoc nhu VN Times, go truc tiep co chu 13, 14, 16
cau_hoi.cau: Cach doi font va co chu?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon trong dropdown hoac go truc tiep co chu.

cau_hoi.A: Fill Color to nen o, Font Color doi mau chu
cau_hoi.cau: Phan biet Fill Color va Font Color?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Fill la nen o, Font la mau chu.

cau_hoi.A: Can trai, can giua, can phai; can giua doc/ngang cho tieu de
cau_hoi.cau: Nhom Alignment can le the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can trai/giua/phai, thuong can giua tieu de.

cau_hoi.A: Orientation xoay chu 45 do hoac nhap do trong Format Cells
cau_hoi.cau: Cach xoay chu trong o?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dung Orientation hoac Format Cells > Alignment > Degrees.

cau_hoi.A: Number: General, Number, Currency, Date, Percentage...
cau_hoi.cau: Nhom Number co cac dinh dang nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So, tien te, ngay thang, phan tram...

cau_hoi.A: Tang/giam chu so thap phan, phan cach hang nghin
cau_hoi.cau: Nut phan cach hang nghin co tac dung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ngan cach hang nghin cho de doc.

cau_hoi.A: Chon vung roi nhan Delete de xoa noi dung
cau_hoi.cau: Cach xoa noi dung nhieu o?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon vung roi Delete.

cau_hoi.A: File > Save de luu bai Thoi khoa bieu sau khi nhap
cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi lam xong thoi khoa bieu thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: File > Save de luu.

cau_hoi.A: Dung de mo file cu
cau_hoi.B: Quick Access Toolbar de gan lenh hay dung nhu Merge & Center, %
cau_hoi.cau: Cau hoi bai 2 ve Quick Access Toolbar la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Co the them cong cu vao thanh truy cap nhanh.

cau_hoi.A: Vao File > Options > General > doi font va co chu mac dinh, khoi dong lai Excel
cau_hoi.C: Doi bang cach mua may moi
cau_hoi.cau: Co doi duoc font/co chu mac dinh khi tao file moi khong?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vao Options > General de doi, khoi dong lai.

cau_hoi.A: Chon vung C3:C10 roi keo rong de de nhin gio hoc
cau_hoi.cau: Cach trinh bay cot gio hoc cho de nhin?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Keo rong cot gio hoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Cac tiet buoi chieu trong vi du la may gio?

cau_hoi.A: Sang 4 tiet, chieu 4 tiet trong vi du
cau_hoi.cau: Thoi khoa bieu mau co bao nhieu tiet moi buoi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 4 tiet sang, 4 tiet chieu.

cau_hoi.A: Boi den 2 o tieu de roi can giua de dep hon
cau_hoi.cau: Tieu de SANG/Chieu nen can chinh the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Boi den 2 o roi can giua.

cau_hoi.A: Bam Don't Save de dong ma khong luu file test
cau_hoi.cau: Khi dong file test ve dinh dang ngay thang thi chon gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon Don't Save de khong luu.

cau_hoi.A: Kiem tra lai Region sau khi doi de chac chan ap dung
cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi doi Region thi nen lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mo lai Excel va nhap thu de kiem tra.

cau_hoi.A: Nen de chuan Anh-My vi tai lieu huong dan chuan hon
cau_hoi.cau: Giang vien khuyen nen de chuan ngay thang nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khuyen de chuan Anh-My.

cau_hoi.A: Mo file len thay ngay 25/2/2020 nam ben phai la dung
cau_hoi.cau: Kiem tra nhap ngay 25/2/2020 dung kieu Vietnam thi thay gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nam sat ben phai la dung.

cau_hoi.A: Thuc hanh lap lai bang thoi khoa bieu cho Thu 3-6 va buoi chieu
cau_hoi.cau: Bai tap ve nha cua bai 2 la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tu nhap cac ngay con lai theo mau.

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Control Panel > Region > Format: English (United States) / Vietnamese
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Doi chuan nhap ngay thang: US nhap thang/ngay/nam, Vietnam nhap ngay/thang/nam. Text can trai, so/ngay that can phai.
cong_thuc.ten: Doi dinh dang Region ngay thang
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon Vietnamese roi nhap 25/2/2020 se can phai la dung; nhap 2/25/2020 se thanh Text can trai

cong_thuc.cu_phap: File > Save (cap nhat) / File > Save As (tao file moi)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lan dau ca hai giong nhau de dat ten; khi da co ten thi Save cap nhat, Save As tao file moi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: File Nhap lieu Thoi khoa bieu: Save de luu tiep, Save As de tao ban moi

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Go o dau > keo fill handle (+) sang phai
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tu dien chuoi Thu 2 den Thu 6 bang cach keo dau cong nho goc duoi phai o.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Go Thu 2 tai D2, keo sang den H2 duoc Thu 3, Thu 4, Thu 5, Thu 6

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Gop nhieu o thanh 1 va can giua, dung cho chu SANG, CHIEU.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den B3:B6 > Merge & Center > go SANG

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Chuot phai > Format Cells > Border > cheo (/ \) > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tao duong gach cheo trong o tieu de B2.
cong_thuc.vi_du: O B2 co gach cheo de chia Thoi gian / Buoi

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Alt + Enter xuong dong; Space can le
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Xuong dong trong cung 1 o va dung dau cach de day chu sat goc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Go Thoi gian, Alt+Enter, go Buoi trong o B2

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Home > Fill Color / Font Color / Bold (B) / Italic (I) / Underline (U)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: To nen, doi mau chu, dam, nghieng, gach chan. Chon font va go truc tiep co chu 13, 16.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tieu de nen vang, chu do, dam, co 13

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Can trai/giua/phai, xoay chu 45 do hoac nhap do trong Format Cells.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Can giua tieu de; xoay 0 do de ve thang

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Formula Bar hien noi dung that; Name Box hien dia chi/dat ten vung
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Formula Bar cho biet o la Text hay cong thuc (=5+14=19). Name Box dat ten vung.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click o co =5+14 thi Formula Bar hien cong thuc, o hien 19

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chen anh mau thoi khoa bieu de nhin va nhap theo, xong Cut de xoa.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Insert > Picture > anh Thoi khoa bieu

cong_thuc.cu_phap: File > New > Blank workbook / Template; File > Options > General doi font mac dinh
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tao file moi tu trang hoac mau lich san; doi font/co chu mac dinh phai khoi dong lai Excel.
cong_thuc.ten: New, Template, Options font mac dinh
cong_thuc.vi_du: New > Calendar template; Options doi Calibri 11 thanh Arial 13

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Home > Number: General, Number, Currency ($), Percentage (%), Comma (,), Tang/Giam thap phan
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dinh dang so: tien te $, phan tram (0.9 thanh 90%), phan cach nghin, tang giam so thap phan.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Go 9 chon Currency thanh $9; go 0.9 chon % thanh 90%

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Boi den vung > Home > Borders > All Borders; chon vung nhan Delete de xoa noi dung
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ke vien bao quanh toan bang; phim Delete xoa noi dung cac o da chon.
cong_thuc.ten: Ke vien va xoa noi dung
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den B2:H10 > All Borders; chon vung nhan Delete

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Data > Filter de loc; View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Panes de co dinh tieu de hang 2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Loc du lieu theo tieu chi; co dinh hang tieu de de cuon xuong van thay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon Filter chi hien Tiet 1; chon hang 3 > Freeze de giu hang 2

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Formulas > Insert Function (fx) de tra cuu ham; Calculation Options: Automatic/Manual; Status Bar hien Sum/Average/Count/Min/Max; Zoom +/-
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tra cuu cu phap ham vi du SUM; de Automatic de cong thuc tu cap nhat; boi den vung xem nhanh tong/trung binh duoi thanh trang thai.
cong_thuc.ten: Chen ham, che do tinh toan va thanh trang thai
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den 2 o thay Sum=16, Average=8; fx go SUM xem huong dan

thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: Tra loi bai cu: Save cap nhat, Save As tao file moi; doi Region US/Vietnam de doi cach nhap thang/ngay.
Buoc 2: Tai folder Bai 2, mo Excel trang, Insert > Picture chen anh thoi khoa bieu mau.
Buoc 3: Nhap Buoi/Tiet: go Thu 2 roi keo fill handle den Thu 6; nhap cac Tiet kem gio 7:30-8:15...
Buoc 4: Boi den vung SANG/CHIEU > Merge & Center; tao gach cheo o B2 bang Format Cells > Border; go Thoi gian Alt+Enter Buoi.
Buoc 5: Boi den toan bang > All Borders; to nen vang, chu do, dam tieu de; can giua.
Buoc 6: Nhap mon hoc theo mau, xoa anh, File > Save voi ten Nhap lieu Thoi khoa bieu.
Buoc 7: Lam quen thanh phan: Formula Bar, Name Box, cac tab File/Home..., nhom Font/Alignment/Number.
